Passively grants ? Reload Speed and 30 Airborne Effectiveness to Shotguns.

Scoring Shotgun or Melee Kills begins Health Regeneration after reaching 100% Progress. <link Minor Combatants [#CombatantClassifications] /> grant 34% progress, while Elites and Guardians grant 50%.

While <void/>Void Overshield, <arc/>Amplified, <solar/>Restoration, <stasis/>Frost Armor, or <strand/>Woven Mail is active:
• Shotguns deal <pve 35% /> <pvp [10%] /> increased damage (<link Empowering Buff [#DamageBuffs] />)
• Melees are granted <pve 30% /> <pvp [?%] /> increased damage
• Shotgun or Melee kills extend the duration of any the above effects by 5 seconds, up to their respective maximum.
• If a <void/>Void Overshield is active, it also recieves 15 HP. 

The following Super 'Melee' Abilities are also granted the damage bonus if the above conditions are met:
• <arc/>Fist of Havoc's Light Attack
• <solar/>Hammer of Sol's Shrapnel
• <void/>Sentinel Shield's Light Attack
• <stasis/>Glacial Quake's Light Attacks
• <stasis/>Glacial Quake's Howl of The Storm

The ability damage bonus stacks additively with the <blue Shieldcrush /> Artifact Mod.
